visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static title screen featuring a red rectangular box with white text centered against a black background. (2) A man with a heavy build, wearing a black T-shirt and a black baseball cap worn backwards with sunglasses perched on top, sits at a white table. He holds a glass of amber liquid, laughing and gesturing towards the side. The background is a high-end restaurant interior with warm, glowing wooden lanterns and dark wood paneling. (3) The camera captures the man in a medium close-up as he speaks animatedly, pointing his finger and adjusting his sunglasses. Yellow subtitles and variety-show style labels like '(霸氣)' appear at the bottom. (4) The scene cuts to a closer shot of the man's face as his expression turns pensive. A blue sweat-drop emoji overlay appears briefly near his forehead. He gestures with his hands while speaking rapidly. (5) He lifts his left sleeve to reveal a faint, curved scar on his upper arm, pointing to it with his right hand. The lighting remains warm and focused on the subject. (6) A hand enters the frame from the side to place a small white paper receipt on the white marble tabletop. (7) The man looks down at the receipt, and his face instantly shifts to a shocked expression with wide eyes and a dropped jaw. He begins to speak frantically, looking off-camera. (8) Promotional graphic overlays for an app titled '街口支付' (JKOPAY) appear on screen. The man points energetically at the camera and demonstrates app functions through hand gestures, including an 'OK' sign. Icons for bill payments and game top-ups float around him. (9) In the final phase, the man leans very close to the camera, shielding his mouth with his hand as if whispering a secret, looking sheepish and embarrassed.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a bouncy, lighthearted piano BGM. A male voice speaks with a mocking, boastful tone, ridiculing others for splitting bills. (2) A sharp 'ding' SFX punctuates his boast about a wealthy friend. The vocal pitch rises as he delivers a punchline. (3) A loud comic impact SFX triggers as the speaker mentions credit card limits. The voice is fast and energetic with high arousal. (4) A comic 'pop' sound occurs simultaneously with the appearance of a sweat-drop emoji. The vocal tone shifts slightly to a more defensive narrative. (5) A clear sound of paper sliding onto a surface (the bill) creates a sudden silence in the speaker's boast. (6) The vocal delivery becomes high-pitched and stuttered, indicating panic and anxiety. The BGM remains steady. (7) The audio transitions into an upbeat electronic track. The voice becomes loud, professional, and clear, following a promotional rhythm to introduce the 'JKOPAY' app features. (8) The BGM cuts out, leaving a hushed, whispering male voice asking for a loan, followed by a final metallic 'boing' comic SFX.
